correctness.rationale: For SPD M-matrices, Schur pivots remain positive and negative off-diagonals cannot cancel, so graphical vertex elimination creates all neighbor clique edges. If the first part is i with monochromatic run R, its first vertex completes every other part, the first outsider then completes the remaining n_i-R vertices of part i, and no more fill occurs. Thus F=M-C(n_i,2)+C(n_i-R,2) exactly; sampling without replacement proves Pr(I=i,R=s)=(n_i)_s(N-n_i)/(N)_(s+1). Missing pair indicator expectation gives E F=sum_i C(n_i,2)(N-n_i)/(N-n_i+2). Optimizing the run gives extrema. For balanced size m, R has uniformly geometric tails and tends to Geom((r-1)/r); scaled M-F and second moments give the geometric law and variance. I independently exhausted 1,012,508 labelled vertex orders on small multipartite graphs, comparing graphical elimination to the exact formula, all matching; this is corroboration only, not the unbounded proof.
